about.title: About Me
about.description: Hello, my name is Keng Keat. I am a second-year Information Technology student studying on a 100% scholarship at The University of Cambodia. Alongside my degree, I gain hands-on industry experience working as a weekend student intern at ETEC Center. My ultimate career goal is to become a professional full-stack software engineer. I specialize in building full-stack web applications using React, Tailwind CSS, Laravel, Spring Boot, and MySQL. I love turning ideas into clean, functional user interfaces and robust backend systems, and I am always excited to tackle new technical challenges.
